from pathlib import Path
import os,json,subprocess,time,gzip,shutil,re,runpy,psutil
R=Path('/workspaces/repository');S=R/'docs/tmp/bootstrap/step-0011-20261023T195335-0700';O=S/'three-directions-paper-check/v2';O.mkdir()
M=O/'memory';M.mkdir();W=runpy.run_path(str(R/'bench/lean-native/linarith-oracle/memory_budget.py'))['MemoryWatchdog']
w=W(os.getpid(),48*1024**3,48*1024**3,2,'/tmp/gpu-smt-failure-profiler-20261025/repl',M)
if psutil.pid_exists(275822):
 p=psutil.Process(275822);assert abs(p.create_time()-1792894799.05)<.01
 w.include_owned_tree(275822,int(Path('/proc/275822/stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[19]),R/'artifacts/lean-failure-profile-2026-10-25/full480/profile')
w.start();T=Path('/tmp/gpu-smt-three-directions-paper-v2-20261025');T.mkdir()
cmd=['/workspaces/.agent-state/gpu-smt-deps/tectonic-0.17.0/tectonic','--keep-logs','--outdir',str(T),'main.tex'];start=time.time()
try:
 q=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=R/'docs/paper',stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True)
 (O/'compile.log.gz').write_bytes(gzip.compress(q.stdout.encode(),mtime=0))
 (O/'main.log.gz').write_bytes(gzip.compress((T/'main.log').read_bytes(),mtime=0))
 (O/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(command=cmd,exit=q.returncode,seconds=time.time()-start),indent=2)+'\n')
 assert q.returncode==0
 shutil.copy2(T/'main.pdf',R/'docs/paper/main.pdf')
 print('COMPILE',q.returncode,re.findall(r'Output written[^\n]+',(T/'main.log').read_text()))
finally:
 w.stop();(O/'memory-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(w.summary(),indent=2)+'\n')
